description: We are two passionate high-schoolers that try to find solutions to certain problems. We try to maximize the quality of our final product. Our aim is to create a simple yet entertaining and educating game that focuses on building your own space program.
summary: Rocketnomics is a simplified space mission game that is focused on the financial and economic decisions that a real space agency has to take in the real life industry. Your goal in the game is to manage all factors such as reliability, risk-taking, success rates and profit margin. According to these managements you select and use the rocket parts on your mission rocket. You are given a random mission contract by the game and these decisions and managements have to be matching and according to that mission contract. Because the game is a simplified version of the real life challenges, it can be played by all age groups that are into space missions and rockets, more specifically the economic and financial part of these missions. We have tried to make it as simplified yet educational for certain age groups. NASA provided data has been used in the making of the game.
details:
-Rocketnomics is a web-based space mission financial management game that is a simplified version of the real life industry.

-The benefits of this game is that is is suitable for all age groups. It is simplified so that it both remains educational and a real life model.

-Our intended impact is to create a understandable and entertaining environment for all age groups, especcialy teenagers and kids.

-The tools we used are Claude, ChatGPT and Netlify. The language of the code is Javascript HTML. The data for the game was the data provided by NASA.

-We didn't want to make a game that is a replica of another existing game. Our team of 2 had interests in economics and spaceflight. Because of this, we decided to combine these 2 interests in order to create an authentic game.

-The main factors we considered was to make this game were accessibility, eduacionality and playablility for all age groups.
